module: Shared controller of "placeable" items for the editor's spline road tools: placing, selecting, dragging and editing items positioned along a road's axis (for example pedestrian crossings, repair groups). A tool can carry several kinds; each registers its "host" table with setHost, and placement, selection, dragging and handles are indexed by kind. The module has no dependency on an unshipped tool folder. The state is global to the module: only one road tool active at a time, each tool calls reset() on activation and deactivation.
usage:
local rp = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_roadPlaceables
-- tool's onActivate:
rp.reset()
rp.setHost({kind = 'crossing', label = 'Crossing', getGroups = getGroups, isRoad = isRoad, itemsOf = itemsOf,
  extentOf = extentOf, frameAt = frameAt, tForPoint = tForPoint, clampT = clampT,
  addItem = addItem, removeItem = removeItem, deepCopy = deepCopy, undo = undo, redo = redo, defaultDepthM = 4})
-- every frame:
rp.handlePlacement(groups); rp.drawHandles(groups, selGroup, false)
notes: Required host fields: kind (unique string), label (name for prompts and undo names), getGroups(), isRoad(g), itemsOf(g), extentOf(item), frameAt(g, t01) -> center, p0, p1 (nil if not ready), tForPoint(g, worldPt, extentM) -> t01, clampT(g, t01, extentM) -> t01, addItem(g, t01) -> item|nil, removeItem(g, idx), deepCopy(g), undo, redo (editor.history:commitAction callbacks), defaultDepthM.
Items carry their normalized position t (0..1, default 0.5) along the road; the handles are at the roadway edges (p0/p1), not on the axis.
The kind parameter is optional everywhere: it resolves to the explicit kind, otherwise the last hovered kind, otherwise the first registered kind.
The handle selection radius is adaptive (0.2 * sqrt(distance) * 0.9) and must stay aligned with splineInput.
drawEditor displays an ImGui editor for a pedestrian-crossing item (title "Pedestrian Crossing", depth slider 1.5 to 8 m, lateral extent, deletion): only useful for a host with depthM and lateral.

setHost.desc: Registers the host of a placeable item kind. To be called in the tool's onActivate, after reset().

host.desc: Host table with kind, label, getGroups, isRoad, itemsOf, extentOf, frameAt, tForPoint, clampT, addItem, removeItem, deepCopy, undo, redo, defaultDepthM.

reset.desc: Clears everything: host registry, placement mode, selection and dragging. To be called in the host tool's onActivate and onDeactivate.

isPlaceMode.desc: Tells whether placement mode is active (for this kind if kind is given, otherwise for any). The host tool owns the Add button and drives these accessors.

setPlaceMode.desc: Enables or disables placement mode for a kind (kind resolved: explicit, hovered or sole).

isDragging.desc: True during a drag along the road.

returns.desc: true if a drag is in progress.

hasSelection.desc: True if an item is selected (of the given kind if kind is provided).

select.desc: Selects an item so that a host list can highlight it.

ci.desc: Index of the item in the group.

underMouse.desc: Finds the closest item handle under the cursor among all kinds (camera ray against spheres at the roadway edges). Also remembers the hovered kind.

clickHandle.desc: Routes a click on a handle: CTRL deletes it (with an undo entry); a simple click selects it and starts dragging along the road (a single click-drag moves it).

handlePlacement.desc: Ghost preview and click to add while placement mode is active (roads only; aimed by camera ray against the axis, so also on elevated sections). Selects the added item.

returns.desc: true if an item was added this frame.

handleSelectDrag.desc: Dragging the selected handle along the road; the selection starts the drag.

returns.desc: true while the module owns the frame (the host then skips the default node/aux drag).

drawHandles.desc: Draws handles and highlight of the existing items, all kinds together, only for the selected road or the road owning the selected item.

showSelected.desc: true if the host's global selection is currently one of these items (selected style versus hover).

drawHover.desc: Hover glow and prompt for the item under the cursor this frame (prompt "drag to move, or CTRL to delete").

drawEditor.desc: Compact ImGui editor of the selected pedestrian-crossing item (depth, lateral extent, deletion).

returns.desc: false when the selection has disappeared (the host then resets its selection kind).
